dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: (Deep, deep, of the potion drink. Feel your body begin to shrink. Up on the table, teacups clink. Where are those feathers... time to think! ...Haha, wonderful!)

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: (Hmm, come to think of it, having a tiny little Mandragora statue play the role of the Dodo-King does seem a little... underwhelming.)

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: (Oh! I should carve a few more when I get a chance. If people really do come over to play, it'll make things a whole lot livelier.)
